## Key facts
- Location: Dunhuang and Jiuquan sit on the Hexi Corridor in Gansu Province, northwest China, connected by a 2.5-hour high-speed train (CNY 150-200).
- Mogao Caves: UNESCO World Heritage Site, 492 painted caves. A-ticket CNY 238-258 covers 8 caves plus two films at the Digital Exhibition Center. All visits are guided; photography inside is forbidden.
- Jiayuguan Fort: western terminus of the Ming Great Wall, built 1372. Combined ticket CNY 120 covers the fort, the Great Wall Museum and the Overhanging Great Wall.
- Crescent Lake & Mingsha Singing Sand Dunes: CNY 120, 5 km south of Dunhuang city.
- Best months: May-June and September-October (15-28°C). Avoid July-August heat and the October 1-7 Golden Week.
- Daily budget: CNY 500-1200 (USD 70-170) per person per day, all in.
